data.name: Hala
data.gender_notes: Hala is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘hal’ meaning ‘ripe’ or ‘mature’. In the Quran, Hala is a female name mentioned in Surah Al-Anbiya. The name Hala carries the meaning “Mature, ripe” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hala usually hope their child will grow to embody mature, ripe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the flow of life and the gentle passage of time.
data.etymology: Hala belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mature, ripe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hala total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

As a spiritual name, Hala is often bestowed upon individuals who have demonstrated remarkable growth and maturity in their faith or character. This could be a reflection of their deeper understanding and commitment to their beliefs or a testament to their enduring resilience and patience in the face of life's challenges. Ultimately, Hala serves as a constant reminder to strive towards spiritual progress and Self-realization, embracing each stage of life as a step towards greater enlightenment and inner peace.
